frontier.mechanism: PERM_RANDOMIZE injects the full pycparser randomizer at a named scope (see tools/decomp-permuter/src/randomizer.py) rather than only shuffling manually-listed lines. Applied to the initial-decl block scope it can invent new intermediate locals, split assignments, or restructure the shift-and-index expression in ways the hand-annotated PERM_LINESWAP + finite PERM_GENERAL alternatives cannot enumerate.
